panel_imagegen.title: Image Generation Settings
panel_imagegen.desc: Connect ShimmerChat to ComfyUI or an A1111-style service. Each configuration has one endpoint, one generation mode and a set of defaults; enabled configurations can be exposed to the model from the Image Generation Tools node. Generated images are always saved to UserUploadImage and returned as /userimages/ links.
panel_imagegen.empty_editor_desc: Pick a configuration on the left, or click 'New configuration' to add an API endpoint.
panel_imagegen.delete_confirm: Delete configuration '{0}'? This takes effect after saving.
panel_imagegen.name: Configuration name
panel_imagegen.id_hint: 1-40 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Used in the tool name generate_image_{id}; id 'default' keeps the name generate_image.
panel_imagegen.description_placeholder: For example: photorealistic portraits with the SDXL checkpoint
panel_imagegen.description_hint: Appended to the tool description shown to the model.
panel_imagegen.base_url_hint_comfy: For example http://127.0.0.1:8188. ShimmerChat calls /prompt, /history/{id} and /view on this address.
panel_imagegen.base_url_hint_a1111: For example http://127.0.0.1:7860. ShimmerChat calls /sdapi/v1/txt2img and the model list endpoints on this address.
panel_imagegen.api_key_hint: Sent as HTTP Basic (user:password) when it contains a colon, otherwise as a Bearer token.
panel_imagegen.workflow_mode_default_des: The built-in ComfyUI graph. The model can override model, size and sampling parameters.
panel_imagegen.workflow_mode_custom_desc: Paste API-format JSON and use {{name}} placeholders for the fields the model may control.
panel_imagegen.workflow_not_supported: A1111 uses the standard txt2img endpoint and does not support custom workflows. Use a ComfyUI custom workflow when you need full control over the request.
panel_imagegen.workflow_json_hint: Paste the API-format workflow exported from ComfyUI. Use {{parameter}} placeholders; placeholders inside a JSON string are escaped as string content, placeholders outside a string are inserted as JSON literals.
panel_imagegen.no_parameters: This workflow declares no parameters. The model can still call it, but cannot customize it.
panel_imagegen.param_enum_values_hint: Comma-separated. Only used for the Enum type.
panel_imagegen.template_help: Validation: every placeholder must be declared, every declared parameter must appear in the JSON, and optional parameters need a default that matches their type.
panel_imagegen.generation_desc: These are the tool defaults. The model can override width, height, steps, CFG, sampler, seed and batch size per call.
panel_imagegen.model_hint_comfy: Click 'Load models and samplers' to read the checkpoint list from ComfyUI, or type the ckpt_name manually.
panel_imagegen.model_hint_a1111: Click 'Load models and samplers' to read the checkpoint list from A1111, or type the sd_model_checkpoint manually; leave empty to use the server's current model.
panel_imagegen.negative_prompt_hint: Used when the tool call does not provide negative_prompt.
panel_imagegen.msg_invalid_param_number: Configuration '{0}', parameter '{1}': {2} must be a number.
panel_imagegen.msg_invalid_base_url: Service URL must be an absolute http(s) URL.
panel_imagegen.msg_probing: Reading the model and sampler lists...
panel_imagegen.msg_probe_partial: Loaded the model list, but failed to read samplers: {0}
imagegen.provider.comfyui.desc: Submits API-format workflows through /prompt and polls /history; supports default and custom workflows.
imagegen.provider.a1111.desc: Generates synchronously through /sdapi/v1/txt2img with standard txt2img parameters; custom workflows are not supported.
imagegen_config.basic_desc: Name, stable identifier, provider, and enabled state.
imagegen_config.name_hint: Identifies this profile in the switcher, nodes, and search results.
imagegen_config.connection_desc: Endpoint, credentials, and timeouts. Probing only refreshes suggestions; it never saves.
imagegen_config.workflow_desc: Use the built-in default workflow, or provide a custom ComfyUI workflow with placeholders.
imagegen_config.custom_workflow_desc: Paste API-format JSON and declare {{name}} placeholders. The 'Generation defaults' group is hidden because custom workflows do not use it.
imagegen_config.empty_desc: Create your first profile and connect to ComfyUI or Automatic1111.
imagegen_config.output_processing_desc: Whether generated results are scaled / compressed to a pixel budget before saving, keeping disk usage and next-round request payloads small.
panel_imagegen.output_processing_hint: Follow global uses the app-wide uploaded-image processing setting; Original always stores bytes as-is; Custom scales images above the pixel budget and re-encodes with the chosen algorithm.
